name: כפל שבר במספר שלם – תוצאה מצומצמת (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Write the following expression as a single fraction in its simplest form:

\({{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}} = \) [[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: A whole number is a fraction with denominator \(1\): multiply it into the numerator, and cancel the common factor of the whole number and the denominator.
Step 1 — Multiply the whole number into the numerator
Note that \(\frac{a}{b}\cdot c=\frac{a\cdot c}{b}\). Therefore in this example:[[if test="{{CT:14}}"]]

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot {{CT:2}}=\frac{{{CT:3}}\cdot {{CT:2}}}{{{CT:4}}}=\frac{{{CT:5}}}{{{CT:4}}} \]

[[else]]

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot {{CT:2}}=\frac{{{CT:6}}\cdot {{CT:2}}}{{{CT:7}}}=\frac{{{CT:8}}}{{{CT:7}}} \]

[[/if]]
Step 2 — Simplify
[[if test="{{CT:15}}"]]The whole number \({{CT:2}}\) and the denominator \({{CT:4}}\) have the common factor \({{CT:9}}\) (their greatest common divisor). Divide both by \({{CT:9}}\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:3}}\cdot {{CT:2}}}{{{CT:4}}}=\frac{{{CT:3}}\cdot {{CT:10}}}{{{CT:11}}}={{CT:12}} \]

[[else]]The whole number \({{CT:2}}\) and the denominator \({{CT:4}}\) have no common factor (their greatest common divisor is \(1\)), so nothing cancels. [[/if]]The fraction \({{CT:0}}\) is already in lowest terms, so after this step the numerator and the denominator have no common factor (greatest common divisor \(1\)). The answer in its simplest form:

\[ {{CT:13}} \]

on_true.feedback: Your answer is algebraically equivalent to \(\frac{{CT:6}}{{CT:7}}\cdot{{CT:2}}\) but isn't fully simplified.
